programme.title: Assimilate (aka Replicate)
programme.desc: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH), Randy (Calum Worthy), and Kayla (Andi Matichak, HALLOWEEN) discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by perfect copies of their victims. Their only chance to survive is to covertly record the invasion in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

programme.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
programme.desc: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

programme.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
programme.desc: After a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of Earth.

programme.title: The Beyond
programme.desc: Astronauts modified with advanced robotics are sent through a newly discovered wormhole. When the mission returns unexpectedly, the space agency races to discover what the astronauts encountered on their groundbreaking interstellar journey.

programme.title: Freaks
programme.desc: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat – or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what’s really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn’t so simple, the danger is very real.

programme.title: False Flag
programme.desc: Sean, a sidelined CIA Officer, struggles with depression after his last Ukraine mission. Bored and yearning for action, he learns of a domestic op by Homeland Security that would put him undercover. But when he discovers it's a series of false flag attacks aimed at dismantling the US Constitution, he must act. After diplomacy fails, he resorts to sabotage and, ultimately, violence to stop it.

programme.title: Wind Walkers
programme.desc: With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.

programme.title: Everybody Loves Sunshine
programme.desc: In Manchester's Pepperhill Estate, cousins and gang leaders Ray (Andrew Goth) and Terry (Goldie) have always relied on each other. Ray, tired of gang life and in love with Clare (Rachel Shelley), wants out. But Terry, obsessed with keeping Ray in the gang, won't let him leave. While they're in prison, the Chinese Triad kills a gang member. As revenge looms, aging gangster Bernie (David Bowie) struggles to maintain peace.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: Lilith
programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: Gehenna: Where Death Lives
programme.desc: A construction group visits the beautiful and remote island of Saipan to search for a new resort location. As they find what they think is the perfect spot, they discover a forgotten Japanese bunker from WW2. While exploring the cryptic remains, they uncover a dark evil that lies beneath the surface. An evil that forces each member to face their darkest secrets and may very well be death itself.

programme.title: The Last Exorcist
programme.desc: After every priest trained in exorcisms dies in a terror attack, one woman must battle a demon from her past that, this time, possesses her sister.
